## Bunker 0.4.0 – one fader from intro to drop 🎚️

### Energy is the arrangement
- The **energy fader** now changes what plays, never how loud. Under 30 it's a **break** – no kick, no bass, the sound closes and opens into the reverb. Going up, kick, bass, open hat and ride come in on the beat. At **90** the build-up starts and two bars later it drops. Take a whole track from intro to drop with one slider (or ← →).
- When Bunker steers the energy (auto mode, songs), it **glides** instead of jumping.

### Auto mode
- **AUTO FX** switch next to LIVE: on, the auto mode plays breakdowns, build-ups and drops by itself – build-ups in four styles (high-pass, low-pass, gate, echo), breakdowns that start in the wash, and now and then a stutter, gate, crush or echo at the end of a phrase. Off, it just grooves and the drops are yours.
- Cycles of 32 to 64 bars – longer in the calm vibes.
- A drop you play by hand makes the next automatic one wait.
- **New chapters** come every few drops and change one or two things, not everything at once.
- Generated loops always stay in step with the beat.

### Songs you can keep
- Everything you hear while a **SONG** plays is recorded, live moves included – when it ends (or you stop it), **save it as a WAV**. The old export menu is gone.

### More to play with
- **Nine moods:** Dreamy, Epic, Sunny and Mysterious join Dark, Hypnotic, Deep, Sad and Euphoric. Each has its own chords, so the bars move instead of repeating.
- **Custom** in the vibe list starts from an empty pattern.
- The **volume** lives on the speaker icon in the top bar (click or scroll).
- The **visualizer** has no text any more – just a small energy bar at the bottom.
- 8-step loops turn with the beam instead of racing ahead; pattern cards and the energy fader are tidier; the swing presets are gone (swing comes with the vibe).

### Downloads

- **macOS 11+** (Apple Silicon & Intel): `Bunker-macos-universal.zip`
- **Windows 10/11:** `Bunker-windows-x64.zip`

The Mac app is not notarized yet: on first launch, right-click → *Open*, or *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*. Windows SmartScreen may ask once: *More info → Run anyway*.
